g.aria-label: Why JAX Small-Vocab Embeddings Need a @jax.custom_vjp Matrix Product
Forward table[X] is a fast parallel gather
" " and "e" tokens stall on the SAME row!
with one dense parallel Tensor Core matmul!
Falls back to nnx.Embed when V > 1,024
Why the V = 1,024 Threshold? At V = 256 (byte GPT in §13.8), one-hot GEMM is 10–30× faster;
one-hot floats would cost too much memory and FLOPs.
